title: Repair dependency state and package-owned integrity
goal: Recover an unconfigured fixture and reinstall damaged package-owned data.
challenge: Diagnose the supplied missing-dependency installation, restore a configured report using only local fixtures, then detect and repair the deliberately changed fixture-owned data file. Preserve unrelated packages, retain failure evidence and finish with exact cleanup.

steps.command: w=/home/learner/ll-discovery-8; test "$(id -un)" = learner && test ! -e "$w" && test ! -L "$w" && mkdir -m 0700 -- "$w" && cd -- "$w" && test "$(df -Pk . | awk 'NR==2 {print $4}')" -ge 65536
steps.explanation: Create a fresh private workspace; stop on collision or insufficient space.
steps.expected: Exact learner path, no existing entry, at least64MiB free.

steps.command: guard() { local links; test "$(pwd -P)" = /home/learner/ll-discovery-8 && test ! -L /home/learner/ll-discovery-8 && test "$(stat -c %U .)" = learner && links=$(sudo find . -type l -print -quit) && test -z "$links"; }; guard
steps.expected: No path substitution; guest root can override guest safeguards.

steps.command: unrelated() { dpkg-query -W -f='${binary:Package}\t${Version}\t${db:Status-Status}\n' | awk '$1!="ll-discovery-data" && $1!="ll-discovery-report"'; }; unrelated > before.tsv; sudo sha256sum /etc/sudoers.d/learning-lab > sudo.before; id learner > learner.before; scope_ok() { guard && unrelated > after.tsv && cmp before.tsv after.tsv && sudo sha256sum -c sudo.before && id learner > learner.after && cmp learner.before learner.after; }; scope_ok
steps.explanation: Retain unrelated package and learner/sudo evidence before any transaction.
steps.expected: Protected unrelated state captured; stop on mismatch.

steps.command: apt_base=(apt-get --assume-yes --no-download --no-install-recommends -oDir::Cache::archives="$w/cache" -oDir::Etc::sourcelist="$w/no-sources.list" -oDir::Etc::sourceparts="$w/no-sources.d"); plan() { guard && sha256sum -c cache.sha256 > cache-check.txt && sudo env LC_ALL=C "${apt_base[@]}" -s "$@" > plan.txt 2>&1 && awk '/^(Reading package lists|Building dependency tree|Reading state information|Correcting dependencies)\.\.\.( Done)?$/ {next} /^Note, selecting .ll-discovery-(data|report). instead of .\/opt\/learning-lab\/package-fixtures\/archives\/ll-discovery-(data_1[.]0-1|report_1[.][01]-1)_all[.]deb.$/ {next} /^ll-discovery-report is already the newest version [(]1[.]0-1[)][.]$/ {next} /^The following package was automatically installed and is no longer required:$/ {next} /^Use \047sudo apt autoremove\047 to remove it[.]$/ {next} /^The following (additional packages will be installed|NEW packages will be installed|packages will be upgraded|packages will be REMOVED):$/ {next} /^  / {for(i=1;i<=NF;i++){p=$i;sub(/\*$/,"",p);if(p!="ll-discovery-data" && p!="ll-discovery-report")bad=1} next} /^[0-2] upgraded, [0-2] newly installed, ([0-2] reinstalled, )?[0-2] to remove and [0-9]+ not upgraded\.$/ {summary++;next} /^[0-2] not fully installed or removed\.$/ {next} $1=="Inst" || $1=="Conf" || $1=="Remv" || $1=="Purg" {n++;if(NF<2 || ($1!="Purg" && NF<3) || ($2!="ll-discovery-data" && $2!="ll-discovery-report"))bad=1;next} /^[[:space:]]*$/ {next} {bad=1} END {exit (bad || summary!=1 || n>4)}' plan.txt && cat plan.txt; }; d=/opt/learning-lab/package-fixtures/archives/ll-discovery-data_1.0-1_all.deb; r1=/opt/learning-lab/package-fixtures/archives/ll-discovery-report_1.0-1_all.deb; r2=/opt/learning-lab/package-fixtures/archives/ll-discovery-report_1.1-1_all.deb; guard && mkdir -m 0700 cache no-sources.d && : > no-sources.list && cp -- "$d" "$r1" "$r2" cache/ && grep '  archives/' /opt/learning-lab/package-fixtures/SHA256SUMS | sed 's|  archives/|  cache/|' > cache.sha256 && sha256sum -c cache.sha256
steps.explanation: Use the same bounded root-context previews as Lesson7.
steps.expected: Only two permitted package identities and exact local archives.

steps.command: guard && sudo dpkg -i "$r1" > failed-install.txt 2>&1; printf 'install status=%s\n' "$?"; cat failed-install.txt; dpkg-query -W -f='${Package} ${db:Status-Status}\n' ll-discovery-report
steps.explanation: A deliberate missing dependency leaves unpacked files but an unconfigured package. Do not execute it yet.
steps.expected: Nonzero status and an unpacked/unconfigured report; dpkg is not an automatic dependency resolver.

steps.command: plan install --fix-broken --no-remove "$d" "$r1" && scope_ok && sudo env LC_ALL=C "${apt_base[@]}" install --fix-broken --no-remove "$d" "$r1" && scope_ok && ll-discovery-report
steps.explanation: Use --fix-broken only with both explicit archives and the reviewed two-name plan; no unrestricted repair or force.
steps.expected: Configured report1.0-1 and known data; normal APT dependency handling.

steps.command: guard && sudo dpkg --verify ll-discovery-data > verified-before.txt && printf 'altered fixture data\n' | sudo tee /usr/share/ll-discovery/message.txt && sudo dpkg --verify ll-discovery-data > damaged.txt; cat damaged.txt
steps.explanation: Modify only this explicitly declared package-owned teaching file. This differs from Lesson6's learner copy.
steps.expected: A recorded content-hash mismatch for usr/share/ll-discovery/message.txt; not an authenticity claim.

steps.command: plan install --reinstall --no-remove "$d" && scope_ok && sudo env LC_ALL=C "${apt_base[@]}" install --reinstall --no-remove "$d" && scope_ok && sudo dpkg --verify ll-discovery-data > verified-after.txt && cat verified-after.txt && ll-discovery-report
steps.explanation: Reinstall the exact reviewed data archive, preserving all unrelated packages.
steps.expected: Quiet verification plus known restored bytes and working report. Compare all evidence rather than exit status alone.

steps.command: plan purge ll-discovery-report && scope_ok && sudo env LC_ALL=C "${apt_base[@]}" purge ll-discovery-report && plan purge ll-discovery-data && scope_ok && sudo env LC_ALL=C "${apt_base[@]}" purge ll-discovery-data && scope_ok
steps.explanation: Remove application then dependency, retaining evidence until review.
steps.expected: Only fixture packages removed; unrelated package inventory/learner/sudo unchanged.

hints: An unpacked executable is not proof the package configured successfully.
Supply the known missing dependency; do not force configuration.
Verify a mismatch before reinstalling, then compare actual restored data.
review: Unconfigured/configured states, exact mismatch, restored package-owned content, real output and unchanged unrelated state.
coverage: LPIC-1 v5.0 102.4 partial dependency repair/reinstallation. Self-reviewed, unscored; not complete objectives.
